**Migration done.** 36 `db.query` calls in 12 files now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`. All files pass `node --check`.

Two calls left in [vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9). Its header says do not edit, since upgrades overwrite it. `db.query` must stay in [lib/db.js:13](lib/db.js:13) for that reason.

Next: pin or patch `legacy-orm` before the driver drops `query`.
